assertion.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core no longer logs that the --enable-composition-functions-extra-resources flag has no effect (Extra Resources are GA) and will be removed. The evidence does not show what happened to the flag itself.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The evidence only shows that the log line saying the flag 'will be removed in a future release' was deleted from core.go in v2.0.0. It does not say whether the flag itself was removed, is ignored, or is still accepted in v2.0.0, and the excerpts contain no flag definitions.; applicability: No change to the flag is established, so no exposure condition can be stated. If the flag turns out to be removed, the exposure would be cli-flag{--enable-composition-functions-extra-resources, set}.; consequence: The evidence does not say what happens in v2.0.0 to environments that still pass the flag (rejected at startup, ignored, or accepted).
